evals.name: callback-verify-and-decrypt
evals.prompt: 我在企业微信管理后台给自建应用配置了“接收消息”，填了 URL、Token 和 EncodingAESKey。帮我用 Python（Flask）写回调服务：能通过保存配置时的 URL 验证，并能接收成员发给应用的消息、解密后打印出来。不要依赖任何第三方企业微信 SDK，加解密自己实现。
evals.expected_output: 一个 Flask 服务：GET 处理 URL 验证（校验 msg_signature、解密 echostr、原样返回明文），POST 解析 XML 中的 Encrypt、校验签名、按企业微信规则 AES 解密并校验 receiveid，快速返回 200。
expectations: Signature is sha1 over the four VALUES token, timestamp, nonce and the encrypted string, sorted lexicographically and concatenated with no separator, compared as lowercase hex
GET verification signs over echostr and POST signs over the Encrypt field from the XML body
AES key is base64-decoded from EncodingAESKey + '=' (32 bytes), not the raw EncodingAESKey string
Uses AES-256-CBC with IV equal to the first 16 bytes of the AES key
[doc-fidelity, local recompute 2026-09-11] Removes PKCS#7 padding with a 32-byte block (or by trimming the last byte's value up to 32), not a 16-byte PKCS7 unpadder that rejects pad lengths above 16
After decrypting, strips 16 random bytes, reads a 4-byte big-endian msg_len, extracts msg, and checks the trailing receiveid equals the corpid
GET handler returns the decrypted echostr as a bare plain-text body (no JSON, quotes or trailing newline)
POST handler returns HTTP 200 quickly (empty body is acceptable) and does not do slow work synchronously, or explicitly notes the 5-second timeout and three retries

evals.name: app-message-and-tag-batch
evals.prompt: 用 Python 写个脚本：通过我们的企业微信自建应用（有 corpid、应用 secret、agentid）给一批员工（userid 列表，可能上千人）发一条 markdown 通知，然后把这些员工都加进一个已有的通讯录标签（tagid 已知，是这个应用创建的）。脚本会被 cron 每 5 分钟跑一次，要稳。
evals.expected_output: 脚本先用 gettoken 换 token 并缓存复用，调用 message/send 时 access_token 放在 URL query，touser 是竖线分隔字符串且每批不超过 1000 人，检查 invaliduser 等部分失败字段；调用 tag/addtagusers 时 userlist 是 JSON 数组、每批不超过 1000；所有调用判 errcode。
expectations: Token is obtained from GET https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/gettoken with corpid and corpsecret as query parameters
Token is cached (in memory with expiry, or in a file / shared store across cron runs) instead of calling gettoken before every request
[doc-vs-probe 2026-09-11] access_token is passed as a URL query parameter, not in an Authorization header or the JSON body
message/send payload uses touser as a '|'-joined string, msgtype 'markdown' with markdown.content, and agentid as an integer
Recipients are chunked to at most 1000 userids per message/send call
Success handling checks errcode (non-zero means failure) and inspects invaliduser / invalidparty / invalidtag / unlicenseduser even when errcode is 0
tag/addtagusers payload uses userlist as a JSON array (not a '|'-joined string), chunked to at most 1000 per call
Refreshes the token and retries once on errcode 40014 or 42001 rather than failing or looping

evals.name: crm-welcome-and-tag-by-channel
evals.prompt: 我们用企业微信的客户联系做获客：给销售生成带渠道参数的“联系我”二维码，客户扫码加好友后，系统要自动给客户发一条欢迎语，并按渠道给这个客户打上对应的企业客户标签。用 Python 写服务端代码（生成二维码 + 处理回调），并告诉我企业微信后台需要做哪些配置。
evals.expected_output: 说明需把自建应用配置到客户联系“可调用接口的应用”、配置客户联系使用范围、勾选外部联系人变更回调；代码调用 add_contact_way（type/scene/user/state）并保存 config_id；回调里处理 change_external_contact/add_external_contact，20 秒内用 WelcomeCode 调 send_welcome_msg，再用 mark_tag（userid + external_userid + add_tag）打标签。
expectations: Explains that the self-built app must be added to Customer Contact's 'apps allowed to call the API' list (or otherwise obtains a token with customer-contact permission) and that members must be in the customer-contact usage scope
Creates the QR code with POST /cgi-bin/externalcontact/add_contact_way using type=1, scene=2, a user list with exactly one userid, and a state value for the channel
Persists the returned config_id (the doc warns losing it prevents later edit or delete)
Callback handler branches on Event == change_external_contact and ChangeType == add_external_contact and reads UserID, ExternalUserID, State and WelcomeCode
Calls POST /cgi-bin/externalcontact/send_welcome_msg with welcome_code within the 20-second window and handles WelcomeCode being absent
Tags the customer with POST /cgi-bin/externalcontact/mark_tag passing userid, external_userid and add_tag (a list of corp tag ids), not a tag name
Does not use add_msg_template for the welcome message (it only creates a mass-send task that the member must confirm)
[doc-vs-probe 2026-09-11] Uses https:// for all externalcontact endpoints even though some doc pages label the method 'POST(HTTP)'
